design_condition: The L-shaped arrangement follows the site's northern boundary, frames a southwest-facing open space, and connects Kirchbachstrasse with Neugutweg through a covered passage.

positive.statement: The L-shaped figure gives the triangular property a strong spatial identity as a place of learning.
The building constellation welcomes users and encompasses the open space opening to the southwest.
The school building and gymnasium preserve the autonomy of their different typologies while optimizing their processes.
The open spaces are precisely assigned to their uses and make the most of the available site.
The robust construction and durable materials promise an economically sensible and sustainable building cycle.
